name: Youth Conservation Corps at Richmond National Battlefield Park
org: National Park Service, Richmond National Battlefield Park
what_you_do: Youth crew members do conservation work at Richmond National Battlefield Park in an 8-week July and August program. Five youth are hired.
who_can_apply: Not stated on the page (ages and residency are not listed).
pay_detail: $7.25 per hour (as posted; page last updated April 2024)
duration: 8 weeks in July and August, Monday to Friday, 8 hours a day. Five youth are hired.
deadline_text: The page says the deadline to apply is June 1.
how_to_apply: Download the YCC application (Word document) and email it to the park contact, or mail it to 3215 E. Broad Street, Richmond, VA 23223. Questions: 804-795-5019 ext. 1.
notes: Only five spots. The page was last updated April 2024, so confirm the year, pay and ages with the park.
